name: @veren/person-agent-preset
description: Use when a DSH deployment needs the bridge between the human and DSH: it registers the "person-agent" preset through ctx.agentPresets at runtime, composing a delegating chief-of-staff persona (understands the need, metacognition first, plain Simplified Chinese, hands work to sessions it creates) whose hard numeric self-work check is the system-prompt suffix, a periodic append-only re-anchor row, workspace and session maintenance tools always on, file tools with edit disabled but write kept for human-facing documents, plus a bundled human-writing skill; skip it when sessions must never create or route other sessions.
